issues.description: Visibility mismatch for attributes declared in the UML vs. the template code. The problem statement's UML shows the Lecture attributes as private (minus sign), while the template pre-declares lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents as public fields. The solution implementation uses private fields for all attributes. This inconsistency can confuse students about the intended encapsulation (whether fields should be public or private) and whether they should add or change existing fields when following the UML and tasks that ask them to "add the corresponding attributes."
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template's attribute declarations consistent with the UML and solution. Either remove the two pre-declared public fields from the template so students add all attributes themselves, or change them to private (matching the UML) and keep TODO comments for the remaining attributes. This preserves the exercise intent while avoiding confusion about field visibility and encapsulation.
